name: Nexkin ArcGuard Insulated Shock Handler
description:
Rubberized dielectric outer shell over a compressed aerogel mid-layer and a moisture-wicking interior mesh. Rated to 40kV dry contact — the standard for live-line electrical maintenance in GLMZ's aging infrastructure grid. The knuckle and palm zones are double-layered; fingertips are single-layer for better feel on terminal contacts. Color is safety yellow with black palm panels, mandated by Tier 2 transit and utility standards.

A wide gauntlet cuff seals over standard work sleeves with a velcro-and-snap system. Versions with an extended chrome-flange channel are available through Nexkin's augment-worker program at a modest surcharge.
functionality: Rated 40kV dry contact insulation; aerogel mid-layer provides thermal buffer against arc flash; double-palm reinforcement for grip durability; gauntlet cuff seals over work sleeves; chrome-flange channel variant available for augmented workers.
what_it_says: You touch the grid with your hands and you've made your peace with that.
story_hooks: A worker survives a 60kV surge that should have killed them — the gloves were rated 40kV, and someone needs to know why they held.
A pair is found in a transit tunnel where there's no scheduled maintenance work, with scorch marks on the palm that don't match any known grid fault location.
The chrome-flange channel variant is being quietly sold in the Gray Zone without the standard rating certification — someone is cutting costs on the dielectric layer.

physical_description.visual_profile: Industrial-grade safety gloves with a bold high-visibility aesthetic. Wide gauntlet cuff extends several inches up the forearm, creating a protective band. The silhouette is bulky through the palm and knuckles, tapering slightly at the fingers for dexterity. Striking safety-yellow dominates with utilitarian black accents.
physical_description.fit: Structured and snug through the hand with compression-fit fingers for tactile control. The gauntlet sits loose enough to layer over standard work sleeves but secured by velcro and snap fasteners to prevent slippage during live-line work.
physical_description.primary_material: Rubberized dielectric outer shell over compressed aerogel mid-layer; moisture-wicking interior mesh lining
physical_description.texture: Outer surface is smooth, slightly tacky rubber with a matte finish designed to grip wet surfaces. Inner mesh is soft and breathable. Double-layered knuckle and palm zones feel rigid and padded; fingertips are noticeably thinner for better contact sensitivity.
physical_description.color_scheme: Safety yellow dominant across back of hand and gauntlet; black rubberized palm panels and finger pads; minimal branding in reflective gray
physical_description.closures: Velcro and snap system at gauntlet cuff; friction-fit fingers with no individual closures
distinctive_features: Wide gauntlet cuff rated to seal over standard work sleeves
Double-layered knuckle and palm zones for impact and heat protection
Single-layer fingertips for enhanced dexterity on terminal contacts
40kV dry-contact dielectric rating visibly certified with regulatory stamps
Optional chrome-flange channel upgrade for augment-worker compatibility
Reflective accent stitching at cuff edges for low-light visibility
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2-3 functional safety wear; regulation compliance signals transit/utility employment
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by electrical infrastructure workers, GLMZ grid maintenance crews, live-line technicians. The gloves announce competence in hazardous-duty repair and adherence to corpo safety mandates. Augment-worker variants signal either augmented limbs or proximity to augmentation tech.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine or lightly scuffed when in active rotation; may show minor burn marks or discoloration from contact with corroded terminals. Well-maintained by safety-conscious workers; worn-out pairs are immediately replaced per regulation.
